The one real soft spot is the scheduling stretch near the end — a customer who cycled through three different dates before settling nearly two weeks out — which the rep handled patiently but didn't tighten with a stronger reconfirm commitment beyond the general Thursday-touch mention.

key_moments.stewart_read: This is a double enthusiasm signal — a newly purchased EV (higher electric load, directly relevant to system sizing) and an unusually large roofline volunteered in the same breath. The rep captured the EV detail later for the design team but never explicitly reflected the roof-size comment back to the customer as a hook.

key_moments.quote: the only requirement is that either of you guys has a credit score of 650 or higher.
key_moments.stewart_read: Rep states 650 as the threshold, matching the same drift previously observed in SESSION18_fcbf33c1, while the schema's documented threshold is 670. This is a second instance of the same discrepancy, suggesting it may be a live floor-wide script variant rather than an isolated rep error.

key_moments.quote: I have you here, Kyle, as the property owner. Is there anyone else on the title of the home with you at all?
key_moments.stewart_read: Customer discloses the home is actually titled in his wife's name, a stronger co-owner signal than a typical spousal mention, and the rep's response was a brief acknowledgment ('No problem at all') without inviting her onto the appointment. Because the follow-up appointment is an in-person specialist visit at the home rather than a phone call, the risk here is more moderate than the phone-coordination scenario protocols.spouse_decision was built around — a specialist visiting the house has some natural opportunity to meet her regardless.

key_moments.quote: No. Actually, I've got something tomorrow.
key_moments.stewart_read: What started as a same-week booking opportunity (specialist available in the area the next day) unwound into three separate date changes before landing nearly two weeks out on Friday the 7th. The rep didn't push back or offer an earlier alternative before Friday's week, simply following the customer's drift.
